title: Learning Consistent Temporal Grounding between Related Tasks in Sports Coaching

problems.name: Multi-Moment, Compositional, and Complex Query Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: Learning Consistent Temporal Grounding between Related Tasks in Sports Coaching Video-LLMs often attend to irrelevant frames, which is especially detrimental for sports coaching tasks requiring precise temporal grounding.

problems.name: Annotation Scarcity and Noisy Supervision
problems.evidence_sentence: We improve temporal grounding without additional annotations by exploiting the observation that related tasks, such as generation and verification, must attend to the same frames.
